'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Eight people are killed and 15 others are injured after two trucks collide head-on in [[Pune]], [[Maharashtra]], [[India]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/8-killed-as-car-gets-sandwiched-between-2-trucks-in-pune-9630482 (NDTV)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention]] reports about 300,000 confirmed and suspected [[cholera]] cases in [[Africa|the continent]], mostly in [[Angola]] and [[Burundi]], and more than 7,000 deaths in 2025, marking Africa's largest outbreak in 25 years and a more than 30% increase from the previous year. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/africa-experiencing-worst-outbreak-cholera-25-years-africa-cdc-says-2025-11-13/ (Reuters)]

**[[Pakistan]]i [[Ministry of Interior (Pakistan)|interior minister]] [[Mohsin Naqvi]] says that [[Afghans|Afghan nationals]] carried out Tuesday's [[suicide bombing]] in [[Islamabad]], which killed 12 people and injured many others, adding that the attack was planned and directed from [[Afghanistan]], increasing tensions between the countries. [https://www.batimes.com.ar/news/amp/economy/bananas-and-beef-white-house-announces-latin-america-trade-deals.phtml (AFP via ''Buenos Aires Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Human trafficking in Spain]]
**[[Spain|Spanish]] [[Law enforcement in Spain|police]] dismantle an alleged [[Transnational organized crime|international network]] accused of [[Trafficking of children|trafficking minors]] from the [[Canary Islands]] to [[France]], arresting eleven suspects in operations in [[Lanzarote]], [[Las Palmas]], and [[Madrid]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/spanish-police-break-up-ring-accused-trafficking-minors-france-2025-11-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Aftermath of the July Revolution (Bangladesh)|Aftermath of the July Revolution]]
**[[Bangladesh]]i [[Chief Adviser of Bangladesh|chief adviser]] [[Muhammad Yunus]] announces a national [[referendum]] on the [[July Charter]], which recognizes the [[July Revolution (Bangladesh)|2024 uprising]] that [[Resignation of Sheikh Hasina|ousted]] former [[Prime Minister of Bangladesh|prime minister]] [[Sheikh Hasina]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/bangladesh-hold-referendum-reform-charter-proposals-yunus-says-2025-11-13/ (Reuters)]
*The [[States and territories of Australia|state]] of [[Victoria (state)|Victoria]] enacts [[Australia]]'s first [[Indigenous treaties in Australia|treaty]] with [[Indigenous Australians|Indigenous peoples]], establishing a permanent [[First Peoples' Assembly of Victoria|First Peoples' Assembly]] and [[Yoorrook Justice Commission|a truth-telling commission]] as part of a formal [[Constitutional recognition of Indigenous Australians|state–Indigenous governance]] framework. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australian-state-signs-countrys-first-treaty-with-indigenous-people-into-law-2025-11-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Tanzania]]n [[President of Tanzania|president]] [[Samia Suluhu Hassan]] appoints [[National Assembly (Tanzania)|MP]] [[Mwigulu Nchemba]] as [[Prime Minister of Tanzania|prime minister]], who is confirmed by [[Parliament of Tanzania|parliament]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tanzanias-president-appoints-mwigulu-nchemba-prime-minister-parliament-speaker-2025-11-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology '''
*In the [[United States]], [[Blue Origin]] launches [[NASA]]'s [[ESCAPADE]] spacecraft mission to study [[Mars]]' [[magnetosphere]]. It is the second launch of Blue Origin's [[New Glenn]] launch vehicle, and the first successful landing of the vehicle's [[Reusable launch vehicle|reusable]] first stage. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/11/13/science/blue-origin-launch-rocket.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Sports'''
* The governing board of [[Major League Soccer]] (MLS), the top men's [[association football]] league in [[Soccer in Canada|Canada]] and the [[Soccer in the United States|U.S.]], votes to change its season from its current calendar-year schedule to a summer-to-spring schedule spanning two calendar years, aligning MLS with most international leagues. The first season under the new calendar will be 2027–28, with an abbreviated transitional season from February to May 2027. [https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/46943880/mls-switching-schedule-align-world-soccer (ESPN)]
